purpose: Archive complete datetime initialization sources, validation, samples, and limitations.

decision.reason: Ordinary construction gains about 1-2% and retained-object peak RSS falls about 2.4%, but custom-metaclass fallback slows about 6-7%. Full-suite workload time and RSS show no overall gain. Keep the primary phase-79 source and CLI unchanged while testing lower guard overhead.
limitations: Native validation ran on ARM64; the added 32-bit storage constructor has not been cross-compiled or run in this experiment.
Existing fold __index__ coercion and native-frame identity differences remain unresolved.
Allocation count and live-allocation profiling were not performed; retained-object peak RSS is a process measurement, not an allocator count.

packing: Original bytes and member paths are preserved. All source versions, failures, corrections, native/release evidence, full census traces, methods, all four performance stages, every sample and load observation are included. Binaries, build dependencies, pyc/stdlib/frozen caches, and the live export log are excluded. ARM64 native validation only; no allocation-count or 32-bit execution claim.

readable_report_formatting.change: Added missing spaces between words and counts; original raw report and all archived data bytes remain unchanged.
